character: Fictional Iowa short oval/road circuit introduced in Forza Motorsport (2023), combining oval-speedway banking with an infield road course layout. No individual corners have established community names.
notes: Community knowledge (no formal corner-name guide available). Character based on official Forza track-list description; no individual corners have established community names.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.type: banked oval corner off the front straight
corners.technique: Commit smoothly, use the banking to carry speed
corners.trap: Hesitating on the banking costs significant time

corners.name: Turn 3
corners.technique: Firm braking, late apex, prioritise a clean exit
corners.trap: Early apex compromises the exit and the following section

corners.name: Turn 6
corners.technique: Commit with smooth steering, carry speed through the corner
corners.trap: Lifting unnecessarily costs momentum through the fast section

corners.name: Final Corner
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical — feeds the front straight
corners.trap: Compromised exit costs time down the entire straight
